# Server client

`createServerClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey, { cookies })` creates a client for
Server Components, Server Actions and Route Handlers.

`cookies` takes exactly two methods:

- `getAll()`: returns every cookie of the request as `{ name, value }[]`.
- `setAll(cookiesToSet)`: writes each `{ name, value, options }`. In a Server
  Component the cookie store is read-only, so wrap the writes in `try`/`catch`
  and let the proxy refresh the session.

The `get`, `set` and `remove` methods of earlier versions are deprecated and
not called; a client given only those never sees the session cookies.
